correctness.rationale: Every proper-image weak idempotent fixes a unique connected arc of length ell and is determined by a bounded lazy walk of length n-ell across the complementary vertices. Cofactor computation proves the rational coefficient formula. The symmetric looped-path adjacency matrix gives a simple positive Perron eigenvalue and uniform spectral dominance at ell of order n^(1/3); the strictly convex saddle phase x log 3+pi²/(3x²) and uniform tail inequalities yield the total and rank concentration. Step-sum constraint gives exact monoid size. Independent exhaustive step-word construction tested n=3..9 with every rank matching transfer dynamic programming. Finite tests do not prove general claims.

value.rationale: A complete natural idempotent rank invariant for all weak endomorphism monoids of cycles, including an explicit rational generating formula, plus the first-order typical rank and stretched-exponential relative density with explicit constants. These differentiate weak Motzkin behavior from the previously known strict Dyck class and produce a nontrivial probabilistic scale rather than a routine constant improvement.
